title: Cloud Security Posture Management
summary: Cloud security posture management is the continuous discovery, assessment and remediation of configuration risk across cloud accounts, covering identity grants, network exposure, storage permissions, encryption settings, logging coverage and compliance against a chosen baseline. A CSPM capability connects to provider APIs with read-only credentials, enumerates every resource in scope, evaluates each against policy rules, and reports the drift between intended and actual state with enough context to prioritise. Its output is deliberately different from a vulnerability scanner: rather than finding flaws in code, it finds misconfiguration in deployed infrastructure, which is the dominant cause of cloud incidents. Effective implementations depend on several disciplines. Rules must be mapped to recognised benchmarks so that findings carry external meaning, and they must be tuned so that each alert corresponds to a real risk, because unmanaged volume produces alert fatigue and silent suppression. Ownership has to route to the team able to fix the resource, and the tool must distinguish misconfiguration that is exploitable now from latent risk. Coverage itself is a risk area, since accounts and regions excluded from scanning are invisible, and a new account created outside the pipeline arrives unmonitored. Mature programmes treat posture findings as code defects, feeding them back into templates and guardrails so the same mistake cannot be redeployed.
objectives: You will be able to explain what CSPM evaluates and how it differs from vulnerability scanning, CSPP and cloud infrastructure entitlement work.
You will be able to map posture findings to a recognised benchmark and justify the priority assigned to each.
You will be able to tune noisy rules without suppressing genuine exposure, and identify the tradeoff each suppression introduces.
You will be able to detect coverage gaps such as unscanned accounts, regions and newly created subscriptions.
You will be able to write a posture finding report that a platform team can act on without further triage.
